en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly carved Baroque relief inside a church. In the central panel, Adam and Eve stand nude on either side of the Tree of Knowledge, whose trunk is coiled by the serpent offering the fruit. The tree fills the frame with dense foliage. Around the panel is an elaborate architectural frame with scrolls and dramatic putti and angels above, holding garlands and ribbons, typical of highly ornate Catholic church decoration.
